description: Publish one part of your team's Claude Code setup to SystemDox: `hooks` (hooks/hooks.json and the scripts/ it calls), `mcp` (.mcp.json), `agents` (agents/*.md), `commands` (commands/*.md) or `instructions` (CLAUDE.md). Every part but instructions makes a new version of the team plugin, which each member accepts at their next update. Publishing hooks, mcp, agents or commands needs the admin role. Pass `directory`: the server reads only the files the part accepts, byte for byte, and refuses a link, a binary file or a file too large before anything is sent. Never retype the files into `files` when the folder is on this computer.

directory.description: The folder on this computer: for hooks, the one holding hooks/hooks.json and scripts/; for mcp, the one holding .mcp.json; for instructions, the one holding CLAUDE.md; for agents or commands, the one holding agents/ or commands/

files.description: Only when there is no folder to read

content.description: The file's full text, exactly as it is

path.description: Path inside the part's folder, forward slashes, e.g. "hooks/hooks.json"

name: publish_setup_part
title: Publish Setup Part
